headline_marked: [[ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox]] face EU's toughest online safety rules
headline: ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox face EU's toughest online safety rules
summary: The European Commission has classified these platforms as very large online entities, imposing stricter content moderation and privacy standards.
details: OpenAI's ChatGPT, along with Reddit and Roblox, will now be subject to the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA). This designation means they must adhere to enhanced obligations, including the removal of illegal content and the protection of minors.

The European Commission stated that these platforms surpassed the 45 million monthly user threshold in the EU, triggering the need for increased scrutiny. Failure to comply with the new rules could result in fines of up to 6% of their global revenue.
This move signifies a significant expansion of the DSA's reach into generative AI services. It follows similar scrutiny on X's AI chatbot Grok, which is already under investigation.

OpenAI has confirmed it is preparing to meet the new compliance requirements. Roblox expressed pride in being the first gaming platform to reach this milestone and emphasized its commitment to safety.

The EU is also actively enforcing its AI Act and investigating potential competition rule breaches by AI services. This regulatory push underscores the bloc's commitment to governing rapidly evolving digital technologies.
The EU maintains that its digital laws apply universally, regardless of a company's origin, despite pressure from the US regarding the regulation of American tech firms.
caption:
ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox are now under the EU's strictest online safety regulations, facing potential fines for non-compliance.

OpenAI's ChatGPT, along with Reddit and Roblox, will now be subject to the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA). This designation means they must adhere to enhanced obligations, including the removal of illegal content and the protection of minors.

The European Commission stated that these platforms surpassed the 45 million monthly user threshold in the EU, triggering the need for increased scrutiny. Failure to comply with the new rules could result in fines of up to 6% of their global revenue.

This move signifies a significant expansion of the DSA's reach into generative AI services. It follows similar scrutiny on X's AI chatbot Grok, which is already under investigation.

OpenAI has confirmed it is preparing to meet the new compliance requirements. Roblox expressed pride in being the first gaming platform to reach this milestone and emphasized its commitment to safety.

The EU is also actively enforcing its AI Act and investigating potential competition rule breaches by AI services. This regulatory push underscores the bloc's commitment to governing rapidly evolving digital technologies.

The EU maintains that its digital laws apply universally, regardless of a company's origin, despite pressure from the US regarding the regulation of American tech firms.
